context: What you're adding, in plain words: gates-shoot is a CI job that tests the shared screenshot command (bin/shoot). GitHub's branch protection keeps a list of checks that must be green before anything can merge into main. merge.py already waits for gates-shoot, but GitHub's own list doesn't name it yet. So a merge done another way, such as the Merge button on github.com, could go in with gates-shoot red. Adding the name closes that gap. No code changes.
steps: Open the branch settings link below.
Next to the rule for main, press Edit.
Find 'Require status checks to pass'. In its search box, type gates-shoot and pick it.
Press Save changes at the bottom.
title: Add gates-shoot to main's required checks in GitHub
